The '''Narmle Bog''' was an expansive bog on the [[Naboo/Legends|Nabooian]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. It bordered the [[Vaydean Marsh]], the [[Lake Octir Swamp]], the [[Madyn Plains]], the [[Narlis Fens]], the [[Narmle Swamp]], the [[Mudflats]] and the [[Asworal Everglades]].<ref name="SWG" /> The bog was named after the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] which location was originally selected for its proximity with the bog. Its founders believed the bog would form a natural protection for the city.<ref name="SWG:N">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Starting Location: "Narmle"</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Narmle Bog first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Its name was revealed in the description of the city of Nashal that was shown to players on the screen that allowed them to choose the starting location for a new character.<ref name="SWG:N" /> These description texts were removed when [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] was made the starting city for all players with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 17 Notes for 26 May 2005|Publish 17]]" on [[May 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
